parameter.label: CODEMP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT CODEMP AS VALUE, CODEMP||'-'||RAZAOABREV AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP WHERE CODEMP < 999 ORDER BY CODEMP

grid.title: GESTÃO DE RECEBÍVEIS - TÍTULOS VENCIDOS - VISÃO POR CLIENTE - Empresa(s) Selecionada(s): :CODEMP
grid.expression:
SELECT 1 AS ORDEM, D.CODPARC, D.RAZAOSOCIAL, (SELECT V.APELIDO FROM TGFVEN V WHERE V.CODVEND = D.CODVEND) AS VENDEDOR, NULLIF(D.TOTALVENCIDO,0) AS TOTALVENCIDO, (D.TOTALVENCIDO / SUM(TOTALVENCIDO) OVER () )*100 AS REP, NULLIF(D.VENC_MES,0) AS VENC_MES, NULLIF(D.VENC_ATE30,0) AS VENC_ATE30, NULLIF(D.VENC_ATE60,0) AS VENC_ATE60, NULLIF(D.VENC_ATE90,0) AS VENC_ATE90, NULLIF(D.VENC_ATE120,0) AS VENC_ATE120, NULLIF(D.VENC_ATE150,0) AS VENC_ATE150, NULLIF(D.VENC_ATE180,0) AS VENC_ATE180, NULLIF(D.VENC_MAIS180,0) AS VENC_MAIS180 FROM(
SELECT CODPARC, UPPER(RAZAOSOCIAL) AS RAZAOSOCIAL, CODVEND, SUM(TOTALVENCIDO) AS TOTALVENCIDO, SUM(VENC_MES) AS VENC_MES, SUM(VENC_ATE30) AS VENC_ATE30, SUM(VENC_ATE60) AS VENC_ATE60, SUM(VENC_ATE90) AS VENC_ATE90, SUM(VENC_ATE120) AS VENC_ATE120, SUM(VENC_ATE150) AS VENC_ATE150, SUM(VENC_ATE180) AS VENC_ATE180, SUM(VENC_MAIS180) AS VENC_MAIS180 FROM( --ORIGEM PORTAL - TIPMOV= "V" SELECT FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PAR.CODVEND, T.TIPMOV, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT AS TOTALVENCIDO, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_MES, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE30, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE60, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE90, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC)BETWEEN 91 AND 120 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE120, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 121 AND 150 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE150, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 151 AND 180 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_ATE180, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) > 180 THEN (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT ELSE NULL END AS VENC_MAIS180 FROM TGFFIN FIN LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = FIN.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = FIN.CODNAT LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = FIN.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = FIN.DHTIPOPER LEFT JOIN TCBPLA PLA ON PLA.CODCTACTB = PAR.CODCTACTB WHERE FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND TRUNC(FIN.DTNEG) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND FIN.DHBAIXA is null AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('V') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND TRUNC(FIN.DTVENC) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) GROUP BY CODPARC, UPPER(RAZAOSOCIAL), CODVEND
)D
UNION ALL
SELECT 0 AS ORDEM, 0 AS CODPARC, '. TODOS' AS RAZAOSOCIAL, NULL AS VENDEDOR, NULL AS TOTALVENCIDO,NULL AS REP, NULL AS VENC_MES, NULL AS VENC_ATE30,NULL AS VENC_ATE60,NULL AS VENC_ATE90,NULL AS VENC_ATE120,NULL AS VENC_ATE150,NULL AS VENC_ATE180,NULL AS VENC_MAIS180 FROM DUAL ORDER BY ORDEM,TOTALVENCIDO DESC, RAZAOSOCIAL

grid.title: GESTÃO DE RECEBÍVEIS - TÍTULOS VENCIDOS - VISÃO POR TÍTULO - CLIENTE: :CODPARC - :NOMEPARC
grid.expression: SELECT FIN.CODEMP, FIN.DTNEG, FIN.DTENTSAI, FIN.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUFIN, FIN.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, (FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP) - FIN.VLRJUROEMBUT - FIN.VLRMULTAEMBUT + FIN.VLRDESCEMBUT As VALOR, FIN.DTVENC, (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) as DIAS_ATRASO, FIN.CODTIPTIT||'-'||TIT.DESCRTIPTIT AS TIPTITULO, FIN.CODNAT||'-'||NAT.DESCRNAT AS NATUREZA, FIN.CODTIPOPER, FIN.HISTORICO, VEN.APELIDO, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') THEN 'Vencido no mês' WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 THEN 'Vencido até 30 dias' WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN 'Vencido até 60 dias' WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN 'Vencido até 90 dias' WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 91 AND 120 THEN 'Vencido até 120 dias' WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 121 AND 150 THEN 'Vencido até 150 dias' WHEN TO_CHAR(FIN.DTVENC,'YYYY/MM') < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY/MM') AND (TRUNC(SYSDATE) - FIN.DTVENC) BETWEEN 151 AND 180 THEN 'Vencido até 180 dias' ELSE 'Vencido mais de 180 dias' END AS CLASSIFICACAO FROM TGFFIN FIN, TGFPAR PAR, TGFNAT NAT, TGFTOP T , TGFTIT TIT, TGFVEN VEN WHERE FIN.CODTIPOPER = T.CODTIPOPER AND FIN.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND FIN.DHTIPOPER = T.DHALTER AND FIN.CODNAT = NAT.CODNAT AND FIN.CODTIPTIT = TIT.CODTIPTIT AND PAR.CODVEND = VEN.CODVEND AND (FIN.CODPARC = :PARCEIRO or :PARCEIRO = 0) AND FIN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND TRUNC(FIN.DTNEG) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND FIN.DHBAIXA is null AND DECODE(FIN.PROVISAO, 'S', 'Sim', 'Não') = 'Não' AND FIN.VLRDESDOB * FIN.RECDESP <> 0 AND T.TIPMOV IN ('V') AND FIN.RECDESP = 1 AND TRUNC(FIN.DTVENC) < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
